shots.see: Government Higher Primary School, Mantihadi. Yellow and red painted front, green doors, coconut palms behind, Kannada name board across the facade. One adult in the lower left corner.
shots.head_en: LAW PARK EDUCATIONAL TRUST // Ten Years · 2016 to 2026
shots.head_kn: ಲಾ ಪಾರ್ಕ್ ಎಜುಕೇಷನಲ್ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ // ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷ · 2016 ರಿಂದ 2026
shots.vo_en: Every year, in villages across Karnataka, children walk to a school like this one.
shots.vo_kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಇಂಥದೇ ಒಂದು ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ನಡೆದು ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
shots.consent: CLEAR after a crop above the adult at lower left
shots.note: Hold the frame still for the first 3s so the title can be read, then a 3 percent push toward the name board. Verify the Mantihadi board lettering on the enhanced render before picture lock.

shots.see: The whole school outdoors on grass in front of the same Mantihadi building. Roughly fifty children and adults, children holding wrapped bags and orange notebooks.
shots.head_en: Everything they own, // in one bag
shots.vo_en: They carry everything they own in one bag. They are bright, and they are ready to learn.
shots.vo_kn: ತಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಇರುವುದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊತ್ತು ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವರಿಗೆ ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಇದೆ, ಕಲಿಯುವ ಹಂಬಲ ಇದೆ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 60 identifiable children and adults
shots.note: Heading sits lower left, clear of the faces. 3 percent push in.

shots.see: Two children in profile, laughing, holding wrapped maroon bags and a geometry and craft kit. A painted fruit chart in Kannada behind them, women standing at the back.
shots.vo_en: And somewhere between that walk and the classroom, a school fee decides.
shots.vo_kn: ಆ ನಡಿಗೆಗೂ ತರಗತಿಗೂ ನಡುವೆ, ಶಾಲಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಒಂದು ತೀರ್ಮಾನ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · two children in close-up, fully identifiable. Highest priority release in the film
shots.note: No push. The laugh sits still. The heading fades up only on the word 'decides' and the last 2.5s are dry: room tone, one piano note, nothing else.

shots.see: Teal and red school veranda. About twenty children holding wrapped bags printed LAW PARK EDUCATIONAL TRUST, a blackboard at right.
shots.head_en: “When it comes to education, no child // deserves to be left behind.” // Charulatha M. R., Founder
shots.head_kn: “ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಮಗುವೂ // ಹಿಂದೆ ಉಳಿಯಬಾರದು.” // ಚಾರುಲತಾ ಎಂ. ಆರ್., ಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪಕಿ
shots.vo_en: For ten years, one Trust has stood at exactly that point, one child at a time.
shots.vo_kn: ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ, ಒಂದು ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಬಂದು ನಿಂತಿದೆ. ಒಂದೊಂದೇ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ.
shots.note: The quote is the act seal. It holds for the last 3s over the photograph with the narration already out.

shots.see: Charulatha M. R. at a white office desk, sari, monitor at left, papers and two succulents on the desk.
shots.vo_en: The Trust was founded by Charulatha M. R. She had been paying school fees for neighbourhood children long before there was a Trust.
shots.vo_kn: ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದವರು ಚಾರುಲತಾ ಎಂ. ಆರ್. ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಶುರುವಾಗುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಬಡಾವಣೆಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಶಾಲಾ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ತಾವೇ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
shots.note: Portrait. No effect on this shot and the next: two faces, two names, let them be quiet.

shots.see: S. M. Manjunatha at a wooden office desk in a suit, monitor and printer at left, calculator and desk phone at right.
shots.vo_en: She was joined by S. M. Manjunatha of Sadenahalli, the first in his family to leave the village to study.
shots.vo_kn: ಅವರ ಜೊತೆಗೂಡಿದವರು ಸಾದೇನಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಎಸ್. ಎಂ. ಮಂಜುನಾಥ. ಓದಲೆಂದು ಊರು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನಗರಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ ತಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಮೊದಲ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ.
shots.note: Source is WebP only. Request a JPEG original before the 4K master.

shots.see: A rural classroom. The founder stands addressing about thirty children seated on the floor. Blackboard with arithmetic behind her, anatomy and map charts on green walls, three men on chairs at the side.
shots.head_en: 2016 · Chickaballapur // First school visit. First scholarship.
shots.head_kn: 2016 · ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರ // ಮೊದಲ ಶಾಲಾ ಭೇಟಿ. ಮೊದಲ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
shots.vo_en: In 2016 they made their first school visit. Chickaballapur. One child. One scholarship.
shots.vo_kn: 2016ರಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರು ಮೊದಲ ಶಾಲಾ ಭೇಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರ. ಒಂದು ಮಗು. ಒಂದು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 30 identifiable children and 4 adults
shots.note: The origin beat. One page turn on the cut, then the last 4s are silent under 'One child. One scholarship.'

shots.see: Children seated in a long row along a veranda wall, hands folded, a steel plate and a green water bottle set in front of each one. The row runs the full depth of the frame.
shots.head_en: 150 students // steel plates and steel glasses
shots.vo_en: On the same visit, a hundred and fifty students received steel plates and steel glasses.
shots.vo_kn: ಅದೇ ಭೇಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರೈವತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಟೀಲ್ ತಟ್ಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಲೋಟ ವಿತರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
shots.note: Push along the line of plates, not into the faces. The 150 numeral carries the heading; set it in the display face.

shots.see: A tiled school veranda open to a garden. Twelve adults and two children standing for a group photograph.
shots.vo_en: In 2017, one became ten. Ten students received scholarships, and the work simply continued.
shots.vo_kn: 2017ರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹತ್ತಾಯಿತು. ಹತ್ತು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ. ಕೆಲಸ ಹಾಗೇ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಿತು.
shots.note: Act 2 into act 3. The whoosh sits on the last 2s, under no narration.

shots.see: A classroom. Blackboard headed Social Science and dated. A woman in a maroon sari stands, a man at right reads from a sheet, two men seated on red plastic chairs, children's heads across the foreground.
shots.vo_en: Year after year, the same roads, the same schools, and more children.
shots.vo_kn: ವರ್ಷದಿಂದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ. ಅದೇ ದಾರಿಗಳು, ಅದೇ ಶಾಲೆಗಳು, ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಮಕ್ಕಳು.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · 4 identifiable adults, children in foreground from behind
shots.note: Act 3 opens. The open field wind bed comes in here and runs to S16.

shots.see: A group of about fifteen adults and children under a large tree beside a small painted village temple, bunting overhead, a dirt yard.
shots.vo_en: Nobody photographs the ordinary years. These are the years the work is made of.
shots.vo_kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಫೋಟೋ ತೆಗೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಕಟ್ಟಿರುವುದು ಆ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದಲೇ.
shots.note: No effect. The bed carries it.

shots.see: A large crowd, well over a hundred people, on grass outside an old school building under a bright blue sky. Red plastic chairs, papers being held up.
shots.head_en: 2020 to 2021 · Pandemic relief // The help did not stop
shots.vo_en: In 2020 schools closed and families lost work. The Trust published a single page, and the help did not stop.
shots.vo_kn: 2020ರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಲೆಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದವು, ದುಡಿಮೆ ನಿಂತಿತು. ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಒಂದೇ ಪುಟದ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ ಹೊರಡಿಸಿತು. ನೆರವು ನಿಲ್ಲಲಿಲ್ಲ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · a crowd, many identifiable faces
shots.note: The 2020 relief poster is text-critical and deliberately not in the enhanced pack, so this 2021 crowd carries the 2020 to 2021 beat. The heading says both years so picture and text do not disagree. If the Trust wants the poster itself, use the un-enhanced K17 from the pack root.

shots.see: A wall of plywood and white shelving, six bays wide and six shelves high, full of books. A bench and two white plastic chairs below.
shots.vo_en: In 2022 the shelves went up. Libraries in rural schools, filled with donated story books and academic books.
shots.vo_kn: 2022ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಪಾಟುಗಳು ಎದ್ದವು. ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯಗಳು, ದಾನದ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದವು.
shots.note: NO FACES. The one shot in act 3 that can take a slow push across the full width without a consent question.

shots.see: The same kind of shelving, filled with colour-coded textbooks. A man sits reading at the left edge, a group of five stands browsing at the right, one with an orange backpack.
shots.vo_en: And unused notebooks, because a book nobody opens is not a library.
shots.vo_kn: ಬಳಸದೇ ಉಳಿದ ನೋಟ್‌ಬುಕ್‌ಗಳು ಕೂಡ. ಯಾರೂ ತೆರೆಯದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
shots.note: Heading goes bottom left, on the empty shelf, not over the people.

shots.see: A large printed Academics and Career Guidance Chart hung as a banner. Two men stand at the left, three women at the right, a laptop and a water bottle on a desk in the corner.
shots.vo_en: In 2023, career guidance for ninth and tenth standard students, at the age when a decision quietly gets made.
shots.vo_kn: 2023ರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ತನೇ ತರಗತಿಗೆ ವೃತ್ತಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ. ಬದುಕಿನ ದಾರಿ ಸದ್ದಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವಾಗುವ ವಯಸ್ಸು ಅದು.
shots.note: The chart carries a third-party project mark. Crop it out or clear it before picture lock: 14 item 2.2.

shots.see: About forty-five children and eight adults packed under an open hall with a bamboo and timber roof, woven mats on the earth floor, craft work laid out in the foreground.
shots.vo_en: The same year the map widened. Mysore. H.D. Kote. And the tribal schools beyond them.
shots.vo_kn: ಅದೇ ವರ್ಷ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಹಿಗ್ಗಿತು. ಮೈಸೂರು. ಎಚ್.ಡಿ. ಕೋಟೆ. ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಶಾಲೆಗಳು.
shots.note: The swell into act 4 sits on the last 3s, under no narration.

shots.see: A school office. Blue walls, green steel cupboards, a Kannada honours board on the wall. A woman in a sari writes on a form at a wooden table, a girl in glasses sits beside her, a boy stands, a man sits opposite, a mother waits at the right holding a book.
shots.vo_en: None of this happens from an office. A principal or a neighbour puts a name forward. The team drives out and sits with the family.
shots.vo_kn: ಇದೆಲ್ಲ ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಆಗುವುದಲ್ಲ. ಮುಖ್ಯೋಪಾಧ್ಯಾಯರೋ ನೆರೆಹೊರೆಯವರೋ ಒಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತಂಡ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಜೊತೆ ಕೂರುತ್ತದೆ.
shots.note: The storyboard crops this to the hands and the form. Keep that crop: it removes the consent question and it is the better picture.
shots.act_en: The way the work is done

shots.see: A volunteer crouches on red earth beside a boy, guiding his hand over a worksheet, paint pot open. A toddler in yellow watches. Adults' feet at the frame edges.
shots.head_en: Up to 75% of the school fee // Paid directly to the school
shots.head_kn: ಶಾಲಾ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ಶೇ. 75ರವರೆಗೆ // ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಪಾವತಿ
shots.vo_en: The Trust covers up to seventy-five per cent of the school fee. Not all of it. The family carries the rest.
shots.vo_kn: ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಶಾಲಾ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ಶೇಕಡಾ ಎಪ್ಪತ್ತೈದರಷ್ಟನ್ನು ಭರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಉಳಿದದ್ದನ್ನು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಹೊರುತ್ತದೆ.
shots.note: SILENCE CUE. Everything drops out under 'Not all of it'. No bed, no effect, room tone only, for 1.5s. The dignity rule: the 25 per cent the family pays is the point of the sentence.
shots.act_en: The way the work is done

shots.see: Overhead view of a tiled floor laid out with crayon packs, watercolour sets, pencils, erasers, sharpeners, geometry boxes and a stack of drawing books, counted into piles.
shots.vo_en: A scholarship on its own is not an education. So there are bags, notebooks, stationery and drawing kits.
shots.vo_kn: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಒಂದೇ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಚೀಲ, ನೋಟ್‌ಬುಕ್, ಲೇಖನ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳೂ ಇವೆ.
shots.note: NO FACES. Brand packaging is visible on the crayon and watercolour packs. Grade it down or crop past it: neighbouring assets were cut from the film for exactly this.
shots.act_en: The way the work is done

shots.see: The open boot of an estate car, filled end to end with stacked notebooks and textbooks, the rear seats and a headrest screen visible through the cabin.
shots.vo_en: In 2024 the Trust opened the school year at the tribal schools of M.M. Hills, with two hundred school bags, notebooks and stationery.
shots.vo_kn: 2024ರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಂ.ಎಂ. ಹಿಲ್ಸ್‌ನ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂರು ಶಾಲಾ ಚೀಲ, ನೋಟ್‌ಬುಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲೇಖನ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಶಾಲಾ ವರ್ಷ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
shots.note: NO FACES. Portrait source, so crop to the boot opening and let the 200 numeral sit in the dark of the car body.
shots.act_en: The way the work is done

shots.see: About thirty children in front of a blue two-storey house under an overcast sky, holding wrapped bags. Six adults behind them, coconut palms and a hillside at the back.
shots.vo_en: Loaded into a car boot in the city. Carried in by hand.
shots.vo_kn: ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರಿನ ಡಿಕ್ಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿ, ಕೈಯಲ್ಲೇ ಹೊತ್ತು ತಂದದ್ದು.
shots.note: Short shot, deliberately. It is the answer to the car boot, not a beat of its own.
shots.act_en: The way the work is done

shots.see: A very large spreading tree over a bare earth clearing. Eighteen people, children in the middle holding wrapped bags, volunteers at both ends. A dog at the left, thatched huts behind.
shots.vo_en: And in 2025, in H.D. Kote, three hundred. This time with Nisarga Foundation beside us.
shots.vo_kn: ಮತ್ತು 2025ರಲ್ಲಿ, ಎಚ್.ಡಿ. ಕೋಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಮುನ್ನೂರು. ಈ ಬಾರಿ ನಿಸರ್ಗ ಫೌಂಡೇಶನ್ ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 8 identifiable children and 10 adults
shots.note: The film's high point. One soft low land on the number, then the remaining 3.5s stay clean. No swell on top of it.

shots.see: Thirty children standing on green grass holding wrapped bags and orange notebooks, four volunteers behind them, a school compound wall and a painted sign in the distance.
shots.vo_en: No stage. No handover photograph. Just a field, and a bag for every child.
shots.vo_kn: ವೇದಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರದ ಫೋಟೋ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ಬಯಲು, ಪ್ರತಿ ಮಗುವಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ಚೀಲ.
shots.note: Crop the animal out of the lower right corner.

shots.see: A yellow classroom with the English alphabet and Kannada letters painted on the walls. About thirty-five children sit on mats with new bags in front of them, hands raised, a volunteer seated at the right.
shots.head_en: The team stays a few days
shots.vo_en: With the children at the tribal schools, the team stays a few days. They teach, they learn, and then the bags are handed over.
shots.vo_kn: ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಶಾಲೆಗಳ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಜೊತೆ ತಂಡ ಕೆಲವು ದಿನ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಮೇಲೆ ಚೀಲಗಳು ಕೈ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 35 identifiable children. Consent critical
shots.note: A second zip, deliberately a different recording from S20, so the pair does not read as one sound used twice.

shots.see: Seven children sitting on a veranda floor against a lime and charcoal wall, each holding up a folded paper triangle in blue, yellow, pink or green. One child in the foreground reaching up from behind.
shots.head_en: Games, drawing, reading, // a stage of their own
shots.head_kn: ಆಟ, ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆ, ಓದು, // ಅವರದೇ ಒಂದು ವೇದಿಕೆ
shots.vo_en: There are games, drawing, reading, and a stage on which children sing and dance.
shots.vo_kn: ಆಟ, ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆ, ಓದು, ಮತ್ತು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹಾಡಿ ಕುಣಿಯುವ ಒಂದು ವೇದಿಕೆ.
shots.note: Portrait source. Crop to the row of raised hands.

shots.see: A blue hall. A banner across the back names Law Park Educational Trust with Belaku Trust and, in Kannada, Soukhya Samrudhi Samsthe. About sixty people: volunteers standing behind a row of new bags, mothers and children seated on the floor.
shots.head_en: In partnership with // Nisarga Foundation · Belaku Trust, Bangarpet // Soukhya Samrudhi Samsthe, Kolar // District Health and Family Welfare Department, Kolar
shots.head_kn: ಸಹಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ // ನಿಸರ್ಗ ಫೌಂಡೇಶನ್ · ಬೆಳಕು ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್, ಬಂಗಾರಪೇಟೆ // ಸೌಖ್ಯ ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ಕೋಲಾರ // ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆ, ಕೋಲಾರ
shots.vo_en: And the work reaches children it would have been easier not to reach. Children of single parents. Children from HIV-affected families.
shots.vo_kn: ತಲುಪಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾದ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನೂ ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂಟಿ ಪೋಷಕರ ಮಕ್ಕಳು. ಎಚ್.ಐ.ವಿ. ಬಾಧಿತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಮಕ್ಕಳು.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 60 identifiable people including children. A health-status claim is spoken over this frame
shots.note: TRUSTEE CONFIRMATION REQUIRED for permission to display each partner's name. Do not name any child over this frame, and do not let the narration line and any single face read as attached to each other: hold wide, no push.

shots.see: Fourteen volunteers standing in a school garden in front of a painted rural school, a tiled porch at the left, a motorbike parked behind.
shots.vo_en: The record that matters is a list of names. Volunteers who are advocates, engineers, counsellors, doctors and homemakers.
shots.vo_kn: ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ದಾಖಲೆ ಒಂದು ಹೆಸರುಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ. ವಕೀಲರು, ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗಳು, ಆಪ್ತಸಮಾಲೋಚಕರು, ವೈದ್ಯರು, ಗೃಹಿಣಿಯರು: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸ್ವಯಂಸೇವಕರು.
shots.consent: REVIEW · 14 identifiable adults and 2 young people

shots.head_en: Udayavani · 19 June 2024 // Bharat Shiksha Ratan Award · 19 December 2025 · New Delhi // Economic and Social Development Foundation
shots.head_kn: ಉದಯವಾಣಿ · 19 ಜೂನ್ 2024 // ಭಾರತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಾ ರತ್ನ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ · 19 ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 2025 · ನವದೆಹಲಿ // ಎಕನಾಮಿಕ್ ಅಂಡ್ ಸೋಶಿಯಲ್ ಡೆವಲಪ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್ ಫೌಂಡೇಶನ್
shots.vo_en: In June 2024 a Kannada daily carried the work from Mulbagal. In December 2025 the Founder received the Bharat Shiksha Ratan Award.
shots.vo_kn: 2024ರ ಜೂನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯೊಂದು ಈ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಿತು. ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷ ಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪಕಿಗೆ ಭಾರತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಾ ರತ್ನ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಸಂದಿತು.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 35 identifiable people including children
shots.note: NO FANFARE. The newspaper clipping and the certificate are both text-critical and deliberately absent from the enhanced pack, so the recognition is carried as text over a school, which is where the work actually happened. Do not name presenting ministers.

shots.see: An auditorium with a curtained stage and a chandelier. About eighty people, many with both hands raised, children kneeling along the front on a red carpet runner.
shots.head_en: Ten Years · 2016 to 2026 // LAW PARK EDUCATIONAL TRUST // Welcome
shots.head_kn: ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷ · 2016 ರಿಂದ 2026 // ಲಾ ಪಾರ್ಕ್ ಎಜುಕೇಷನಲ್ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ // ಸ್ವಾಗತ
shots.vo_en: Ten years. One promise, kept quietly, one child at a time. Welcome to the tenth anniversary of Law Park Educational Trust.
shots.vo_kn: ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷ. ಸದ್ದಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಂಡ ಒಂದು ಮಾತು. ಒಂದೊಂದೇ ಮಗು. ಲಾ ಪಾರ್ಕ್ ಎಜುಕೇಷನಲ್ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್‌ನ ಹತ್ತನೇ ವರ್ಷದ ಸಂಭ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆತ್ಮೀಯ ಸ್ವಾಗತ.
shots.consent: BLOCKING · approximately 80 identifiable people including children
